videos.title: Power your AI transformation with a complete data platform: Microsoft Fabric
videos.description:
With Microsoft Fabric, you can give your teams the AI-powered tools needed for any data project in a pre-integrated and optimized SaaS environment. You can even extend Fabric further with native, industry-specific and partner-created workloads. 

You can access your entire multi-cloud data estate from a single data lake, work from the same copy of data across analytics engines, and ensure your data is ready to power AI innovation. All this data can then flow to everyone in your organization with visuals embedded in the Microsoft 365 apps they use every day and AI-enhanced Q&A experiences that help everyone uncover insights. 

Fabric also comes with category-leading performance, instant scalability, shared resilience, and built-in security, governance, and compliance so you can feel confident using Fabric for your mission-critical workloads.

Learn more: https://msft.it/6052Wqjga

videos.title: Fabric demo | An end-to-end tour of the OneLake catalog
videos.description:
The OneLake catalog is designed to serve as the central access point for data for both business users and data professionals—making trusted data easy to find while ensuring it’s properly governed and protected across OneLake. 

The OneLake catalog comes with three tabs, Explore, Govern, and Secure, that can help all Fabric users discover, manage, and secure trusted data. 

This quick demo provides an end-to-end tour of the OneLake catalog to highlight everything it has to offer.

videos.title: FabCon+SQLCon Europe Keynote: The Data Foundation for AI
videos.description:
Every organization deploying AI faces the same obstacle: agents and apps are only as good as the data beneath them. Yet data estates are often fragmented across operational, analytical, and real-time workloads, on-prem and in the cloud. Agents are left with siloed, poorly governed data that undermines trust and stalls innovation. Join Microsoft leadership to see how Fabric, OneLake, and databases come together to solve this challenge by providing a single governed foundation for data and semantics. You’ll learn what’s new across Microsoft SQL and open-source engines like PostgreSQL, why unifying databases and analytics accelerates development, and how Fabric IQ gives every agent the business context to power reliable analysis and action. See how Fabric is shaping the future of enterprise data and bringing trusted intelligence into day-to-day work, everywhere decisions are made.
 
Join us at the next FabCon/SQLCon in your area:
 
North America: https://msft.it/6058aWXcr
Europe: https://msft.it/6059aWXcT
APAC: https://msft.it/6050aWXcp

Learn more: https://msft.it/6051aWXcV

videos.title: Introducing Planning in Fabric IQ
videos.description:
Planning in Fabric IQ is a new enterprise planning capability that enables organizations to create plans, budgets, forecasts, and scenario models directly on top of Fabric’s semantic models. By complementing Fabric IQ’s ontologies with integrated planning, you get a complete, contextual view of your historical, real-time, and forward planning data. This allows users and agents to quickly answer what has happened, what is happening, and what should happen all from a single source.

Read the blog to learn more: https://msft.it/6054QoZWM

videos.title: Integrating Fabric with Azure AI Foundry Demo
videos.description:
Organizations can now use Azure AI Foundry to connect customized, conversational agents, created in Fabric. A critical component of Azure AI Agent Service is the ability to securely ground AI agent outputs in enterprise knowledge, so that responses are accurate, relevant, and contextually aware. Data agents in Fabric, formerly known as AI skills, can retrieve knowledge using a number of specialized query language tools that help AI to generate SQL, KQL and DAX. By combining Fabric’s sophisticated data analysis over enterprise data with Azure AI Foundry’s cutting-edge GenAI technology, businesses can create custom conversational AI agents leveraging domain expertise.

Read the blog to learn more: https://msft.it/6051qLQPW
